answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 21101 Country: India Title: is it true that every human being born in this world will recieve the word of ALLAH...i mean will all the humans including the non muslims come to know abt Islam before they die? i am asking this bcoz one of my non muslim frend died recently aged 15 yrs...i dnt knw wether he died a muslim or not, but i feel he had very less time to understand the meaning of islam and its importance!!!plz reply in detail. Question: salam mufti sab, is it true that every human being born in this world will recieve the word of ALLAH...i mean will all the humans including the non muslims come to know abt Islam before they die? i am asking this bcoz one of my non muslim frend died recently aged 15 yrs...i dnt knw wether he died a muslim or not, but i feel he had very less time to understand the meaning of islam and its importance!!!plz reply in detail.jazakalah Answer ID: 21101 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 675/445/L=1431) Almighty Allah has created too many signs in His creatures that if a man ponders over it he can recognize Almighty Allah. If man reflects inside himself he can come to know Almighty Allah. And when a man is in this world and specially where Muslims are present and the message of Islam reaches him, then accepting Islam is obligatory on him. Had he been in such a deserted place where he could not receive the message of Islam then too he had to believe in Allah in order to get salvation. The age of fifteen is enough to learn the religion of Islam and to know Almighty Allah; hence if your friend died at the age of fifteen he died in the state of kufr . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
